register_task: register a custom EmbodiedTask subclass with the Habitat registry using the register_task decorator
register_simulator: register a custom Simulator subclass with the Habitat registry using the register_simulator decorator
register_sensor: register a custom Sensor subclass with the Habitat registry using the register_sensor decorator
get_task: retrieve a previously registered EmbodiedTask class from the Habitat registry by its name
register_dataset: register a custom Dataset subclass with the Habitat registry using the register_dataset decorator
